lines.en: Shin Yoosung opened her eyes to dazzling headlights. White lights crisscrossed the air. A hovering drone spun around near her face, then receded into the black sky.
“Ugh, my head······.”
Dizzy and disoriented, Shin Yoosung staggered to her feet.
All she could see around her were heaps of scrap metal.
The companions who had been with her were nowhere in sight.
······Had she been stranded here alone?
“Shin Yoosung?”
A boy poked his head out of the scrap heap like a little squid.
“Lee Gilyoung?”
Just as Shin Yoosung turned toward him in delight, a woman pressed down on Lee Gilyoung's head and sprang from the heap.
“Move! It stinks!”
“Jihye-unnie!”
That more or less answered the question of who had come with her.
The companions got up, brushing off the rubbish clinging to their bodies.
“What, is it just us?”
“It looks that way.”
“The Busan Alliance is back together.”
Lee Jihye sounded rather excited. Shin Yoosung did not share her enthusiasm.
Of all people, Lee Jihye and Lee Gilyoung.
Looking from one face to the other, Shin Yoosung made a silent resolution.
'I'm the only adult here. I have to do this right.'
Whether or not they knew what she was thinking, Lee Jihye and Lee Gilyoung glared at each other, then abruptly began establishing their pecking order.
“Ahem. Kids, we should pick a leader like we always do, right?”
“You led the Busan Alliance, noona. So this time it's me.”
“Hey, you weren't even born when I started kindergarten.”
“What does that have to do with anything?”
“Shh. Both of you, be quiet!”

At Shin Yoosung's voice, all three instinctively pressed themselves against the wall as though they had agreed beforehand. A split second later, a drone flitting through the air like an insect lit up the alley where they had just been standing.
Whirrrrr······.
The drone hovered there briefly, then tilted its sensor and disappeared out of the alley. Lee Jihye asked tensely.
“Isn't that a drone?”
Just then, a system message sounded in the air.
[Someone has intervened in the scenario system!]
[An unprecedented power has forcibly summoned you to 'Next City' on the 'Main Island'!]
['Next City' is currently isolated in space and time from the conflict zone of the 'Great War of Saints and Demons.']
[By resolving this area's sub-scenario, you can enter the 'Great War of Saints and Demons.']
“Next City?”
Lee Gilyoung's eyes sparkled.
“Let's go check it out!”
“Don't act like a kid, Lee Gilyoung. This isn't a game.”
Despite Shin Yoosung's warning, Lee Gilyoung ran off.
Fortunately, no drones were visible nearby, and the wall they had been hiding against stood on higher ground than they had thought.
“Wow, this······.”

A spectacular view of the whole city at a glance. Photoelectrons brilliantly lighting up the night streets. Androids with blue light streaming from their heads roamed the streets like a procession of demonstrators.
One look told them what kind of world setting this was.
Lee Gilyoung spoke confidently.
“I'm gonna get crazy strong here and give Dokja-hyung a real surprise.”
“He'd be most surprised if you died here.”
“······Why do you hate me so much, noona?”
Leaving the squabbling pair alone, Shin Yoosung studied the city spread out below.
Apart from a little unrest caused by the demonstrations, the city seemed to run according to a well-organized system. A science-fiction world with a level of order she had never seen before.
They said Reincarnation Island was a graveyard of declining Stories.
Then why had a world like this fallen?
Of course, whether she pondered that question or not, Lee Jihye and Lee Gilyoung were busy chattering excitedly.
“Do you think they have lightsabers?”
“You and your sword obsession······.”
“Shut up.”
“Huh, those guys over there really do have something like lightsabers.”
“What? Where?”
Guards patrolling the city were roaming the nearby area. Was it the influence of this world setting? When she studied them closely, an information window appeared before her eyes.
[Lv.12 Patrol Android]
[This unit is approximately four times stronger than you currently are.]
Lee Jihye muttered in alarm.
“What? Why are they so strong?”
“I think we're the ones who've gotten weaker.”
Indeed, since they had entered this world, the concentration of magic power around them had noticeably decreased.
[Your primary stats are reset within this world setting.]
[This world setting is adjusted by a 'Level System.']
“Damn it, they're coming this way!”
How had they noticed? The guards were suddenly charging toward them.
Looking up, she saw several drones circling above them.
[Story energy signature detected!]
[Story energy signature detected!]
With a warning cry, the guards accelerated, boosters firing from their backs as they swooped in together.
Lee Jihye, Shin Yoosung and Lee Gilyoung each drew their weapons.
“Damn it, there aren't even any bugs here······ Shin Yoosung, can you summon the Chimera Dragon?”
“Its cooldown isn't over yet.”
[Your current level is 1.]
[Hunt low-level enemies to gain experience.]
Looking utterly miserable, Lee Jihye drew her long sword. She was the only one in their group who specialized in close combat.
Quickly activating [Demon Slaying] and [Ghost Walk], she confronted a guard to protect the children. Just as its lightsaber was about to clash with her sword.
Whirrrrr!
The lightsaber slipped straight past Lee Jihye's sword and slashed her forearm.
“Aaaaagh!”
[The android 'Lee Jihye' has been seriously injured!]
[Administer Story energy to survive.]
Lee Jihye backed away, but it was already too late.
“Move!”
Shin Yoosung pushed Lee Jihye aside and stepped in. Her face deathly pale, Lee Jihye screamed at her, and Lee Gilyoung reached out.
But the lightsaber was already plunging toward the crown of Shin Yoosung's head.
'Ajusshi.'
In that instant, Shin Yoosung reflected on her short life. The injustice of having it end in a place like this. Yet the satisfaction of knowing her choice had not been wrong.
Shin Yoosung thought.
This was an end worthy of the incarnation of the 'Demon King of Salvation.'
And the next moment.
[This attack has no effect on you.]
Tzzzzzt. Amid flying sparks, the guard's lightsaber stopped right before her nose, as though blocked by an invisible wall.
“Huh?”
Messages appeared in the air, one after another.
[An error has occurred in the scenario system.]
[The Giant Story 'Next City' questions the existence of the incarnation 'Shin Yoosung.']
The same thing was happening to Lee Gilyoung. The lightsabers being used to attack the children were all switching off.
Staring blankly upward, Lee Gilyoung muttered.
Pale gray lettering glowed in the upper-right corner of their vision.
[This scenario is rated 18+.]
[Under its content rating, this world setting restricts the killing of child and adolescent units.]
Shin Yoosung's eyes met Lee Gilyoung's.
'······What a freaking jackpot.'
They did not know how they had been summoned here.
But if this was the kind of world they were in.
Lee Gilyoung grinned at Lee Jihye, who stood behind them with her mouth hanging open.
“Get ready for some free power leveling, noona.”
Watching Lee Gilyoung drive his dagger into the guard's thigh, Shin Yoosung thought.
'Maybe staying a kid just a little longer······.'
Shin Yoosung did not yet know what awaited them at the end of this scenario.
But there was one thing she did know.
When this scenario ended, they would probably have grown strong enough to astonish Kim Dokja.
I was startled by the constellations waiting for us beyond the portal. Even a cursory count showed that there were far more than one or two.
······Had they known we were coming?
“Dokja-ssi.”
At Lee Hyunsung's tense voice, I nodded.
Yoo Joonghyuk, Han Sooyoung, Lee Hyunsung, Jung Heewon. The five of us, myself included, stood clustered together like a single constellation.
A scenario message soon appeared.
[The main scenario has been updated!]
[You and your nebula have entered the neutral zone of the 'Great War of Saints and Demons'!]
[You may choose a camp in the 'Great War of Saints and Demons'!]
An announcement followed, painting the sky in every color.
[The nebula 'Kim Dokja’s Company' has entered the 'Great War of Saints and Demons'!]
The work of those damned dokkaebis, obviously.
Advertising our arrival to the whole neighborhood the moment we showed up.
[Many constellations have noticed your presence!]
[Some nebulas are watching your actions!]
It was hardly an ideal situation, but there was nothing I could do about it now.
I faced the constellations watching us from the other side. Constellations radiating quite formidable Status.
I recognized some of them.
[Successor, you are very late.]
A man smiling at us with quiet dignity. Delighted, I called out.
“Goryeo’s First Sword!”
It was Cheok Jungyeong, whom we had parted from during the 'Middle Island scenario.'
As befitted a constellation who had reached Narrative-grade, he seemed to have entered the Main Island without trouble.
[You seem to have completed quite an epic scenario. Your party has grown.]
Cheok Jungyeong's gaze settled on the reincarnators emerging from the portal behind us.
They were the people of the 'Kaizenix Archipelago' who had crossed to the Main Island with me.
“They'll be joining us in the 'Great War of Saints and Demons.'”
Cheok Jungyeong nodded.
[The more forces, the better. That aside······ Something seems different about you, successor.]
Cheok Jungyeong looked me up and down as though examining me.
[I sense a strange depth in your Stories.]
His gaze passed over me and moved to Han Sooyoung. She met it with an irreverent look that seemed to say, What are you staring at?
An unusual light flickered in Cheok Jungyeong's eyes.
Suddenly, I recalled what 'Mandala’s Guardian' had said.
―Bodhisattva, try enduring time.
After we cleared the Kaizenix Archipelago, our nebula's Stories had undergone a certain change.
Lee Hyunsung, Jung Heewon, and especially Han Sooyoung. The time they had endured in Kaizenix had by no means been wasted.
Everything was recorded as a Story, and that Story, in turn, nurtured our Status.
Perhaps it was because of Cheok Jungyeong's words, but I felt the constellations spying on us from behind grow even more blatant in their scrutiny.
[The constellation 'Expert at Sitting on the Fence' takes an interest in you.]
[The constellation 'King of Archers' watches you with interest.]
[The constellation 'Three Mouths but only One Head' mocks the reincarnators of the 'Kaizenix Archipelago.']
The reincarnators from the Kaizenix Archipelago backed away from that feast of Status.
Now that they had left the archipelago, they no longer enjoyed the protection of its world setting.
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' growls!]
Han Sooyoung stepped forward as if to protect them. The atmosphere writhed, and the Black Flame Dragon's aura rose behind her. The reincarnators bowed their heads to her in reverence.
So that must be what it meant to be a king.
But the constellations seemed displeased with her.
In an instant, their auras turned menacing.
Rrrrrumble!
[How dare an incarnation from a minor nebula······!]
Feeling rather annoyed, I thought it was time to put a stop to this.
[The Giant Story 'Torch That Swallowed the Myth' glares at the constellations!]
Startled by the Giant Story stirring, the constellations took several steps back.
Seizing the opportunity, I asked Cheok Jungyeong.
“Let's leave it at that. Why were you waiting for us?”
Cheok Jungyeong looked somewhat troubled, as though weighing whether he should tell me.
A few possibilities came to mind, and I decided to test one.
“I understand this is neutral territory. Have you chosen a camp in the Great War of Saints and Demons, Goryeo’s First Sword?”
[Not yet.]
······I see. Still hadn't picked a side?
Cheok Jungyeong continued.
[As you know, Good and Evil (善惡) among constellations are not the same as they are among mortals. Frankly, I do not wish to belong to either.]

Like me, Cheok Jungyeong had begun as a mortal and risen to constellationhood through his own strength. He probably disliked the concepts of Good and Evil espoused by the archangels and Demon Kings. I could understand his dilemma.
But that applied only to Cheok Jungyeong.
Glancing at the constellations behind him, I asked.
“I suppose they haven't chosen sides either.”
Cheok Jungyeong nodded.
Behind him, groups of constellations were scattered across the vast plain, their tents pitched here and there.
[How is the war progressing?]
[From what I've gathered······.]
True Voices drifted faintly from all directions.
I laughed inwardly.
The real reason they had yet to choose a camp was perfectly obvious.
The constellations in this neutral zone were watching and waiting, planning to join the Great War of Saints and Demons on whichever side would benefit them most.
Yoo Joonghyuk and Han Sooyoung initiated [Midday Tryst] at the same time.
―I think I see what's going on.
―These bastards are doing that thing, aren't they?
I nodded.
The stronger the uncommitted 'neutral' forces became, the more they could gain when they chose a camp.
[The constellation 'Prisoner of the Golden Headband' scorns the constellations in the neutral zone.]
[The constellation 'Hell's Scribe' says that the hottest places in Hell are reserved for those who remain neutral in times of moral crisis······.]
Good or Evil, these people intended to sell their strength to one side on the best possible terms when the time came.
Han Sooyoung gave a little laugh.
―Their intentions couldn't be more obvious.
It was then that Cheok Jungyeong, after agonizing over it again and again, spoke with something like a sigh.
[Someone wishes to meet you.]
[Who?]
[A high-ranking constellation from the nebula <Hongik>.]
Just as I thought.
It seemed Cheok Jungyeong had come here to recruit us.
Concealing a faint disappointment, I asked.
“Weren't <Hongik>'s high-ranking constellations said to have disappeared?”
I had certainly heard that long ago.
Once at the 'Constellation Banquet,' and once more while facing the 'Mother of the Founder' in [Dark Castle].
[They have not disappeared. One stands before you now.]

A True Voice imbued with lofty Status. The ranks of constellations parted, and a divine immortal (神仙) holding a snow-white folding fan walked toward us. Every step carried the majestic force of the wind.
······I think I know who this is.
[Kneel and show your respect, descendant of the Peninsula.]
Appearing out of nowhere and demanding we kneel······.
Beside me, Han Sooyoung looked incredulous, while Yoo Joonghyuk's hand was already moving toward his sword hilt.
Cheok Jungyeong pressed a hand to his forehead. Apparently, he had known this would happen.
―I am sorry, successor. I tried to dissuade him, but to no avail.
Of course. He couldn't possibly enjoy a situation like this.
But he owed <Hongik>, so he could hardly refuse to arrange this meeting······.
―I leave it to your judgment.
I nodded and turned toward the immortal.
[The constellation who rules the winds of the Peninsula reveals his modifier!]
[The constellation 'Heavenly Wind God' looks at you!]
Heavenly Wind God. A constellation who had founded <Hongik> alongside the Heavenly King (天王).
His true name was 'Pungbaek (風伯),' familiar to us as the god of wind.
Rrrrrumble!
The Status of a constellation who had revealed his modifier. A terrifying gale swept around us like an immense phoenix beating its wings. Then all sound vanished.
The reincarnators outside were shouting something toward us, but I could not hear them. He had cut off every sound around me.
It was probably a sign that he did not want our coming conversation overheard.
[Descendant of the Peninsula, I have heard much of your valor. As your fame spreads far and wide, the Peninsula's standing rises with it. This god finds that most gratifying.]
I gave Yoo Joonghyuk a look as he built up his aura.
Wait. Let's hear him out first.
[Yet recently, I have heard that you are forging improper alliances with the constellations of foreign lands.]
······Though I was beginning to wonder whether we should keep listening.
[Archangels and Demon Kings are not constellations originating in the Peninsula or East Asia. In other words, they are foreign powers (外勢).]
Han Sooyoung shot me a look.
―Hey, are you just going to let him go on?
―I'll cut him down.
―What, crossed wires? Why can I hear Yoo Joonghyuk?
―I merged the Tryst rooms.
My words set off a barrage of messages from Han Sooyoung and Yoo Joonghyuk.
―Are you kidding me? Now I have to listen to that arrogant voice inside my head too?
―I was about to say the same.
I sighed at the two of them growling at each other.
―Both of you, stop. That's not what matters right now.
Even as we fought in our group chat, Pungbaek's tedious lecture continued.
[······In short, your pro-foreign conduct has gravely dishonored the Peninsula, and this god considers it a serious sin. Yet if you deeply repent and reflect upon your actions······]
There was even a constellation who agreed with him.
[The constellation 'Founder of National Isolation Policy' partially agrees with the 'Heavenly Wind God.']
Of course, not everyone felt that way.
This little Peninsula had an astonishing variety of constellations.
[The constellation 'Bald General of Justice' wipes his head.]
[The constellation 'First Spiritualist of Joseon' clicks his tongue.]
[The constellation 'Prisoner of the Golden Headband' yawns.]
[Some constellations of the Korean Peninsula find the remarks of the 'Heavenly Wind God' old-fashioned.]
[Who dares wag their tongue while hiding behind an anonymous modifier!]
With Pungbaek's thunderous True Voice, the weather began to change. Cowed by that terrifying might, several constellations fell silent at once.
After all, he was practically an ancestral god of the Peninsula.
Having benefited from <Hongik> to varying degrees, the Peninsula's constellations could not openly challenge his authority.
Not even Cheok Jungyeong.
[And why are you still standing?]
Pungbaek's gaze fixed on me.
The atmosphere changed completely.
[I told you to kneel, did I not?]
An immense pressure bore down on me. Not just me, but the whole of <Kim Dokja’s Company>.
[The Stories of the nebula <Hongik> stare at <Kim Dokja’s Company>!]
It felt as though an ancient, enormous tree had bent down to look at us.
A tree coveting the nutrients of a newly sprouted seedling.
I quietly met that gaze, then answered.
“I don't want to.”
[Yes, you don't······ What?]
“I said I don't want to.”
[The constellation 'Prisoner of the Golden Headband' likes your attitude.]
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' urges you to start with one good punch.]
“I came to participate in the 'Great War of Saints and Demons,' not to kneel before you.”
[Such arrogance. I intended to pardon your sins out of regard for your valor―]
“And after you pardoned me?”
Pungbaek's eyebrows twitched at my words.
“You planned to use <Hongik>'s authority to absorb <Kim Dokja’s Company>, didn't you?”
I seemed to have struck a nerve. Even that lofty constellation's face betrayed emotion.
[It is only natural that you should come under <Hongik>'s command.]
“Why?”
[Had <Hongik> not exerted its power in the beginning, your nebula would never have been born.]
Pungbaek shouted at me like a parent betrayed by his child.

[<Hongik> founded the Peninsula! We gave birth to you, set the course you were to follow, and laid down your laws. Everything you see, feel and think now was determined by us. You exist because of <Hongik>'s Stories, and through those Stories you can survi―]
“Four years ago, by Earth's reckoning, the 'scenarios' began on the Korean Peninsula.”
I cut him off.
“What did <Hongik> do when the Peninsula was in peril?”
“When the Korean Peninsula's scenarios began, when the [Absolute Throne] appeared, when Outer Gods and disasters descended, and the Peninsula's incarnations and constellations all joined forces―”
Each word brought memories to mind.
Scenarios that people with no one to turn to had come together to overcome.
The [Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword] plunging toward the blind throne, and the Peninsula's constellations lending that sword their probability.
[The Story 'King of a Kingless World' glares at the 'Heavenly Wind God.']
[The Story 'King of a Kingless World' begins its story!]
The Story was stirring independently of my will.
「King of a Kingless World」 was a Story born with the destruction of the [Absolute Throne].
I told the Story, and through me, the Story spoke of itself.
“Back then, where were you and <Hongik>? What were all you magnificent constellations doing?”
Tzzzzzzzt······!
[You bastard!]
Pungbaek stared at me, looking as though he might cough up blood.

“Of course I know that you and <Hongik> worked to benefit the Peninsula in its early days. I acknowledge the value of your Stories. But that doesn't mean everyone on the Peninsula owes you their loyalty.”
Watching his mustache tremble, I finished.
“Everyone has their own way of carrying out the 'scenarios.' Being one of the Peninsula's highest-ranking constellations doesn't give you the right to interfere with <Kim Dokja’s Company>'s affairs.”
Cheok Jungyeong actually seemed to enjoy my audacity.
He had probably never seen anyone treat Pungbaek like this before.
[How dare you, how dare―]
As Pungbaek stood speechless, the imposing presence of a Story rose behind him in his stead.
[The Giant Story of the nebula <Hongik> looks at you!]
[The nebula <Hongik> extends its roots toward <Kim Dokja’s Company>!]
One by one, <Hongik>'s Giant Stories rose like branches toward the sky, then formed the shape of an immense tree.
And I recognized it.
「The tree that connects heaven and earth, the sum of the Stories <Hongik> puts into practice. A single Story that supports them all.」
「The Story Tree (說話木), Shindansu (神壇樹).」
All of <Hongik>'s Stories had begun with that tree.
Shindansu scattered sacred energy as it extended its branches of Story toward us.
The lecture hadn't worked, so now he was resorting to force. It left a bitter taste.
But what was truly bitter was―
“It looks like <Hongik>'s highest gods really have disappeared.”
[······What do you mean?]
Unlike the Shindansu I knew, this was far shabbier, little more than a miniature. And the tips of all the roots reaching toward us were horribly damaged. Long deprived of nutrients,
the Giant Stories could no longer maintain their shapes. Even most of the branches and trees sprouting through those roots had withered.
That was all <Hongik> had left now.
“I'm saying this because I feel sorry for you.”
The 'Pungbaek' I knew from the original was not such a crotchety old man.
He had not been warm, but he had been a far more dignified and just constellation.
Yet something had happened to <Hongik>, and the nebula's power had shrunk drastically.
Pungbaek's present desperation was certainly connected to that incident.
[You dare humiliate this god?]

Pungbaek shrieked and unleashed the power of the wind. The force of an immense storm began to gather around us. Under the tremendous Status pressing down on the area, the reincarnators from the Kaizenix Archipelago writhed as though in pain.
Han Sooyoung pressed me again.
―Kim Dokja.
I nodded.
I felt sorry for <Hongik>, but ultimately, that was their problem.
As I stepped forward, Yoo Joonghyuk drew his sword beside me, and Han Sooyoung unwound the bandages on her left arm. Then.
[The Giant Story 'Demon Realm's Spring' begins its story!]
[The Giant Story 'Torch That Swallowed the Myth' begins its storytelling!]
The Giant Stories we had held back opened their mouths together.
Even.
[The Giant Story 'Kaizenix Archipelago' joins in the storytelling with apparent displeasure.]
Even a Giant Story that was not ours joined them.
Shwaaaaah!
The great tree's roots flying toward us were breaking apart in the waves our Stories raised.
[The miniature of the Giant Story 'Shindansu' suffers!]
The roots that had reached toward us as though to swallow us at any moment faltered and scattered. As though frightened by a story they could not devour.
The intact roots belatedly retreated, and the withered, bare branches screamed.
[The miniature of the Giant Story 'Shindansu' refuses the command of the 'Heavenly Wind God.']
Shindansu withdrew its roots, and its form vanished in an instant.
Apparently never having imagined that our Giant Stories possessed such Status, Pungbaek staggered back in shock.
I could feel the constellations scattered about the neutral zone turning toward the disturbance in surprise.
[Baat!]
Biyoo appeared above my head as though she had been waiting. At the same time, I felt her channel open wide.
[Many constellations enter the channel!]
Biyoo's channel was connected to Bihyung's relay channel.
I could just picture Bihyung enjoying himself.
His intentions in steering things this way were obvious.
I didn't like it, but this was certainly something I would have to do someday.
[The constellation 'Bald General of Justice' listens closely to your voice!]
[The constellation 'Maritime War God' awaits your story.]
[The Demon King 'Ruler of Eastern Hell' watches you.]
[The constellation 'Scribe of Heaven' is waiting for you.]
[Good-, Evil-, and Neutral-aligned constellations are watching you.]
Countless indirect messages from constellations appeared.
Looking at Pungbaek, I spoke.
This was no warning to <Hongik>.
“I won't claim that everything we do is just. But we will decide our own path.”
To the constellations of the world, I declared.
“No one can stand in the way of that choice.”
As though they had been waiting, gazes poured down from the sky.
[The constellation 'Bald General of Justice' agrees with you.]
[The constellation 'Maritime War God' nods at your words.]
[The constellation 'Prisoner of the Golden Headband' mutters that there is no need to state the obvious twice.]
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' urges you to hurry up and punch the old geezer.]
At the Abyssal Black Flame Dragon's words, Pungbaek glared up at the sky in apparent disbelief.
He was about to say something when the next indirect message made him flinch.
[The constellation 'Goryeo’s First Sword' thinks the 'Demon King of Salvation' is right.]
Pungbaek's head snapped toward Cheok Jungyeong.
[Jungyeong, even you······!]
Looking embarrassed, Cheok Jungyeong avoided his gaze.
Frankly, I was surprised.
Declining though it was, <Hongik> remained the Korean Peninsula's leading nebula.
Under those circumstances, it could hardly have been easy for Cheok Jungyeong to oppose <Hongik>'s wishes and take my side.
[Many constellations take an interest in the clash between <Kim Dokja’s Company> and <Hongik>!]
Perhaps because of Cheok Jungyeong's declaration, I could feel the constellations focusing on me. Some watched me warily as a new wind blew through the neutral zone.
I looked at Pungbaek.
“Will you continue?”
Watching his eyelids tremble violently, I honestly didn't feel good about it either.
I had spoken as though condemning <Hongik>, but I knew that Pungbaek had not entirely abandoned the Korean Peninsula's scenarios.
Because Pungbaek was the very constellation who had lent my mother his power during the 'Returnee War.'
Even if, damn it, that had robbed my mother of her entire lifespan.
Maybe that was why I was so angry.
[The wind will not forget what happened today.]
After glaring at me for a long time, Pungbaek snapped his folding fan shut and vanished like dust.
[A considerable number of constellations admire your spirit!]
[A few constellations remember that <Kim Dokja’s Company>'s name is no empty boast.]
[The <Star Stream>'s gossipmongers record this incident.]
Yoo Joonghyuk, Han Sooyoung, Jung Heewon, Lee Hyunsung.
They were all watching me, but none of their faces showed fear.
They were probably all thinking the same thing I was.
It didn't matter how others saw our nebula or what judgments they made.
We would simply move toward the story we believed was right.
[A choice worthy of you, successor.]
Cheok Jungyeong spoke as he watched us.

[Some constellations will like you and follow you for that quality. Indeed, many constellations on the Korean Peninsula now watch you more closely than <Hongik>. But······ the number of those hostile to you has grown as well.]
I became conscious of the surrounding gazes anew.
Some constellations glared at us. Others watched us with apparent envy. Still others shook their heads, their eyes seeming to say we would end up just like them.
「We, too, were once like you.」
The Stories the constellations had lived through felt close enough to touch.
[Ancient Giant Stories look at <Kim Dokja’s Company>'s Story.]
Every Story was a trace of overcoming a scenario.
Times that had once been someone's entertainment.

All the Stories that had come this far had let themselves be broken to survive. Time spent compromising with the reality of the <Star Stream>, agreeing to the demands of constellations and dokkaebis to stay alive. And so, at last, they stood here.
As though speaking for all that time, Cheok Jungyeong said.
[The <Star Stream> dislikes stories that will not break. All the more so when they are as pure as yours.]
Unbroken purity······.
I laughed at those words.
It surprised me that the world saw us that way.
Because those words denied every step of the road we had walked.
“We've already been broken dozens of times.”
<Kim Dokja’s Company> had not stood on its own two feet from the beginning.
Since the Korean Peninsula's scenarios began, we had come this far enduring the constellations' manipulations and inexplicable hatred. Just like countless other Stories.
“But every time, we got back up. That's why we're here now.”
To call us 'pure' after all that was an insult.
[The Giant Story 'Demon Realm's Spring' looks at you calmly.]
[The Giant Story 'Torch That Swallowed the Myth' swallows a fierce cry.]
The two Giant Stories reacted as though agreeing with me.
“And we'll keep getting back up, as many times as it takes.”
[The germinating third 'Giant Story' stirs.]
And so did the third Giant Story that would soon awaken.
Watching us, Cheok Jungyeong slowly nodded.
[I will watch your story.]
With those words, he turned away. The constellations of the Korean Peninsula who followed him also departed, glancing back at us.
Cheok Jungyeong had now surpassed Historical-grade and reached Narrative-grade.
He had also been a constellation far longer than I had. A born fighter, he would be the finest ally if we could bring him to our side.
Of course, that applied only if we could fight on the same side.
Perhaps I had been striking a pose for too long. Han Sooyoung, watching beside me, tapped my shoulder.
―Hey, someone might mistake you for the protagonist.
Feeling awkward, I glanced at Yoo Joonghyuk. But he wasn't looking at me. He was gazing far off toward the horizon.
“It's begun.”
[A scenario event is occurring!]
[A local battle in the 'Great War of Saints and Demons' is scheduled near this area!]
At the next system message, neutral constellations and incarnations camped all around us sprang to their feet in alarm.
[Intervening in the conflict zone will present you with a choice of camps!]
In the distance, I could see two mighty forces advancing.
White-winged angels in dazzling armor led incarnations and reincarnators across the plain, coloring it silver.
From the other side, Demon Kings steeped in impure and demonic energy advanced with their vassals.
[The updated main scenario has arrived!]
<Main Scenario #80 ― 'Great War of Saints and Demons'>
Category: Main
Difficulty: Unmeasurable

Clear Conditions: Choose either the Absolute Good or Absolute Evil camp and participate in the Great War of Saints and Demons. As your camp accumulates victories in the scenario, its 'Good/Evil Points' will increase. Once a camp's points exceed 100, the outcome of the war will be decided.
Time Limit: This scenario's time limit is affected by 'Chaos Points.'
Reward: A Giant Story related to the 'Great War of Saints and Demons,' ???
Failure: Death

Absolute Good Points: 56
Absolute Evil Points: 56

We read the scenario details in silence for a moment.
Han Sooyoung was the first to speak.
“Kim Dokja, what do we do? Our usual thing again?”
[The constellation 'Hell's Scribe' says that the hottest places in Hell are reserved for those who remain neutral in times of moral crisis······.]
“He won't stop babbling, and that isn't even his own line. Seriously.”
[The constellation 'Hell's Scribe' flinches and falls silent.]

'Hell's Scribe' was Dante, author of the 『Divine Comedy』. And that famous saying of Dante's had actually been adapted by a politician of a later age. Still, since it had helped make him famous, Dante would have accepted it as his own Story.
「The hottest places in Hell are reserved for those who remain neutral in times of moral crisis.」
It sounded impressive. Though I didn't know what it meant in a world where even moral choices became someone else's entertainment.
“This time, we have to choose too. We can't keep slipping out of it forever.”
Regardless of Dante's words, we, too, faced a choice between two alternatives. We couldn't participate in this 'Great War of Saints and Demons' at all without choosing Good or Evil.
Looking at the message, Yoo Joonghyuk spoke.
“The 'Great War of Saints and Demons' in the 1863rd round ended in Evil's victory. Han Sooyoung sided with Evil.”
“Why is it me again? And this isn't the 1863rd round, you know?”
Han Sooyoung was right.
This was not the 1863rd round.
This was the third round, the world of <Kim Dokja’s Company>.
“Let's go.”
In the distance, I could see a fierce battlefield where the two forces of Good and Evil were colliding.
One of the battlefields in this vast 'Great War of Saints and Demons' had just opened.
[The 113th local battle of the 'Great War of Saints and Demons' is occurring!]
[The list of participants in this local battle is revealed.]
And on the front line of that Great War of Saints and Demons stood a constellation I knew well.
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' is participating in this scenario.]
“Spare me, please spare me.”
Shhkk!
“Archangel-nim, please······!”
Groans from all directions.
The incarnations who had chosen Evil from the two options were losing their heads to the archangels' swords.
This is a war of Stories.
Having to be utterly excluded by one side simply for belonging to the other's Story.
Leaving the fallen incarnations behind, Uriel surveyed the battlefield without expression.
Once, the archangel Uriel had pitied them.
She had grieved for the incarnations swept up and consumed in a vast narrative, and raged at their suffering. She had felt that way for a long time. Once, that had been her whole life.
'······I need to catch up on the Star Stream broadcasts.'
Watching the surging Demon King army, Uriel chewed on her lip.
Being born to spread Good does not mean one can spend an entire lifetime doing nothing else.
What truly wears a constellation down is not physical danger, but the erosion of the mind.
Emotional labor sustained over eons had brought her a deep-rooted disillusionment with the world itself, and profound madness.
[The soul of the constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' trembles unsteadily.]
Strong or weak, no constellation can feel safe within the scenarios.
That is the kind of system a scenario is.
Roooooar!

To forget that they are being consumed within the scenarios. And to live one more day, constellations consume other Stories. They watch scenarios voyeuristically, rage at someone's plight, hurl abuse, feel admiration, or are moved.
The archangel Uriel was no exception.
[■■■■■ Get lost! I missed the live broadcast because of you!]

[Hell Flames Ignition] streamed from Uriel's blade, burning the Demon King's vassals to ash. In her haste, she failed to control her power properly. It was also largely because she had rushed into battle after summoning only half her true body.
[The Demon Kings participating in the local battle are astonished by the archangel's power!]
Of course, even if it was only half her body, it was still half the body of none other than the archangel Uriel.
Most Demon Kings could not hope to match her.
[The Demon King 'Monarch of Stars and Logic' releases his Status!]
[The Demon King 'Grand Duke of Dragons and Foul Odour' unleashes his Giant Story!]
[The Demon King 'Speed of Sound Demon King' lets out a blood-red cry!]
[The Demon King 'Duke of Everywhere' is engulfed in excitement and madness!]
The problem was that the Demon Kings participating this time were no ordinary Demon Kings either.
Uriel's expression hardened as she watched the Demon Kings advance through her [Hell Flames Ignition].
[The mad archangel is right before us!]
[Do not fear! I, the Demon King Buer, am with you!]
They were not the Demon Kings originally scheduled to participate in this local battle. But the Demon King army had suddenly changed its lineup, leaving Uriel to face them alone.
[You ■■■! Get lost!]
Arrows laden with demonic energy filled the battlefield. Uriel activated [Hell Flames Ignition] like a barrier to block them.
While she looked after the lower angels retreating in haste, arrows lodged all over her own body too, before she knew it.
[How laughable. Angels, are you fleeing?]
[So much for the reputation of the 'Demon-like Judge of Fire'.]
[Shut up! If I could have descended with my whole true body, you'd all be dead.]
Under the barrage, Uriel fumed without so much as a groan.
[Stop ganging up on me like cowards and fight me one on one, you ■■! ■uck! One on one, I could wreck Agares, Gamigin, Marbas, any of them!]

The Demon Kings sneered at Uriel's furious cry. They knew she was strong. That was why no fewer than four Demon Kings had come to take down one archangel. And they remained meticulous to the very end.
[This is war, angel.]
Blood-drenched Uriel's [Hell Flames Ignition] clashed with the Demon Kings.
The archangel Uriel was strong.

With the power of only half her body, she had cut an arm off the 'Monarch of Stars and Logic' and crushed the pet dragon cherished by the 'Grand Duke of Dragons and Foul Odour.' The 'Speed of Sound Demon King' had even lost both legs.
But that was as far as she got.
The moment she turned at a sudden chill, the transparent Duke of Everywhere's dagger came flying toward her heart.
[Today, I shall feast on an archangel's Story.]
Realizing her mistake, Uriel belatedly swung her sword. But her wounded incarnation body had grown sluggish, making it difficult to respond. And the next moment.
Shh-shhk!
A blade shining pure white pierced the Duke of Everywhere's chest from behind.
Black blood pattering down.
The sword stabbed his back again and again. Until Story fragments burst grotesquely from him and the ruined incarnation body's life was utterly extinguished.
Then a sword of white light flashed in and sent the Duke of Everywhere's head flying.
[Someone has killed the Demon King 'Duke of Everywhere.']
Then Uriel saw the two people standing behind the fallen Duke of Everywhere.
People she could have recognized from any distance were so close.
“I can't stand by and watch my constellation get beaten like that.”
Her one and only incarnation in this world.
And.
[The Demon King 'Demon King of Salvation' has won the 'Demon King Promotion Battle'!]
[The Demon Realm grade is being adjusted!]
[The Demon King 'Demon King of Salvation' has become the 'Demon King of the 50th Demon Realm'!]
The protagonist of the story she had watched for so long spoke.
“It's been a while, Uriel.”
[The Demon King 'Demon King of Salvation' has chosen his camp.]
There are times when someone's expression feels utterly raw.
Moments when you feel you're seeing that person's true expression.
[Kim Dokja―!]
That was how Uriel looked to me now.
Reaching out with all her strength, Uriel embraced Jung Heewon and me, rubbing her cheek against us for a long time. Eventually, Jung Heewon scolded her.
“Uriel, I can't breathe.”
[S-sorry.]
Eyes still sparkling even as she drew back in embarrassment. Sometimes, I truly can't understand how such a silly archangel acquired the modifier 'demon-like.'

[How did you know to come here? Hm? Did the 'Kaizenix Archipelago' scenario go well? I barely managed to watch a few parts, but I didn't have much time······ I'm so sorry! You're not upset because I didn't donate anything, are you? I didn't do it on purpose―]
Not only her expression, but every word was utterly raw.
Listening to Uriel, Jung Heewon and I looked at each other. She was probably feeling what I felt.
Words without elegant phrasing or painstaking revision.
Yet some words are most moving when left raw.
“Uriel. I understand. But we should leave the details for later.”
[Hm? Oh, right. This isn't the time.]
Uriel's gaze shifted from me to the Demon King army glaring at us from across the way.
Seeing her expression turn cold in an instant, I realize my doubts were unfounded.
This angel is unmistakably a 'Demon-like Archangel of Fire.'
[The Demon King 'Monarch of Stars and Logic' cannot understand your actions.]
And there were Demon Kings standing against that archangel.
Tenth in the Demon King rankings, 'Buer,' Monarch of Stars and Logic.
Eighteenth in the Demon King rankings, 'Bathin,' Speed of Sound Demon King.
Twenty-ninth in the Demon King rankings, 'Astaroth,' Grand Duke of Dragons and Foul Odour.
Even excluding the Duke of Everywhere, who had died at my hands, three Demon Kings remained. Every one of them was a formidable enemy.
Especially the 'Monarch of Stars and Logic' and the 'Speed of Sound Demon King.'
If both Buer's arms or both Bathin's legs had been intact, I might have had to risk my life here.
[Demon King of Salvation!]
[What is the meaning of this? Why are you fighting your fellow Demon Kings?]
I shrugged shamelessly and made an excuse.
“I was just fighting a Promotion Battle.”
[You think that excuse makes any sense right now······.]
“There's no law against attempting a Demon King Promotion Battle during the 'Great War of Saints and Demons,' is there? It happened often during the 'First Great War of Saints and Demons,' too.”
Enraged by my words, Bathin looked vicious enough to tear my head off immediately. But with both legs gone, there was nothing he could do.
[You have reenacted part of the 'First Great War of Saints and Demons'!]
[The Demon King 'Asmodeus' takes an interest in your unexpected actions.]
In fact, what I had done was exactly what the Demon King Asmodeus had done in the First Great War of Saints and Demons.
His expression hardening, Buer, the 'Monarch of Stars and Logic,' asked.
[Do you think you will get away with this?]
“Of course I won't.”
Not remotely cowed by their auras, I raised my Status.
“But I'm not the one who should be worried right now.”
[Releasing the Demon King's Status!]
[Activating the exclusive skill 'Bookmark'!]
[Bookmark slot 5 has been activated!]
[The exclusive skill 'Electrification (電人化) Lv.23(+13)' has been activated.]
[Your current physical composition differs from that of the relevant character.]
[Your 'Status' overcomes the penalty imposed by your physical conditions.]
The sensation of wings breaking through my skin made my shoulders itch.
With the tingling sensation of Electrification added to it, my whole body was enveloped in lightning.
The three Demon Kings looked bewildered as my 'Status' soared.
The 'Monarch of Stars and Logic,' missing one arm.
The 'Grand Duke of Dragons and Foul Odour,' missing his pet dragon and covered in wounds.
And the 'Speed of Sound Demon King,' already out of the running as a fighting force with both legs gone.
Beside me, Jung Heewon drew her [Sword of Judgement] and activated [Demon Slaying].
“I was disappointed that my last fight with a Demon King got cut short······.”
As the Demon Kings began backing away, Uriel quickly grew triumphant and spoke.
[You ■■ were running your mouths just fine earlier, weren't you? Go on, say something else!]
[Dokja, Heewon. Let's go! Let's wreck every one of those Demon King ■■······!]

I caught Uriel's shoulder as she advanced in a fury, dragging her ruined incarnation body along. A shoulder that had become so frail. Helpless in my grasp, Uriel turned to me with wide, startled eyes.
“Uriel, please step back.”
[Hm? Oh······ Are you worried about me? It's fine. I'm Uriel!]
Looking touched, she clasped my hand tightly. The sight saddened me a little, and I smiled quietly.
“That isn't what I mean.”
[The Demon King 'Demon King of Salvation' has chosen his camp.]
The announcement of my participation hung in the air. Uriel probably hadn't read it properly.
Still puzzled, Uriel began to stiffen. Her eyes slowly widened.
Meeting her eyes, I spoke.
“Stay still, Uriel. This will be over soon.”
Perhaps, by now, she was reading the message I could see too.
[The camp chosen by the Demon King 'Demon King of Salvation' is Evil (惡).]
“Kim Dokja's gone and done a Kim Dokja again.”
Watching the battlefield from afar, Han Sooyoung muttered.
The battlefield had been settling into a lull, but Kim Dokja's abrupt intervention was driving it toward chaos.
A Demon King who had killed a Demon King. A Demon King who, even so, made no attempt to hide that he was 'Evil.'
She could see the lower angels moving to surround Kim Dokja, and Jung Heewon's troubled face.
Seemingly worried, Lee Hyunsung asked.
“Is he really going to be all right doing that?”
“And if he isn't? Should we tell him to side with <Eden> now? Kim Dokja's a born Demon King.”
Grumbling, Han Sooyoung looked toward Yoo Joonghyuk.
“You're not just going to watch, are you?”
“Of course not.”
“No need to ask. I'm choosing Evil (惡).”
Han Sooyoung's constellation sponsor was the 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon.'
She hadn't had much of a choice to begin with.
“What about you, Yoo Joonghyuk?”
“What does your sponsor say? No answer?”
Instead of answering, Yoo Joonghyuk looked at the incarnation bodies strewn across the battlefield. Some were the corpses of angels and Demon Kings, but most were human―reincarnators.
“See anyone you know?”

Silently, Yoo Joonghyuk looked down at the fallen reincarnators. A few who were still writhing reached toward him. Their wounds were too severe; it was too late to save them. He bent down and drove his dagger into their throats. Then they fell asleep with peaceful expressions.
Watching this, Yuri di Aristel spoke.
「Sooyoung.」
'Don't worry, Yuri. I won't let that happen to you.'
She can see the dead reincarnators' souls scattering.
Trapped in the mandala's cycle, reincarnators would live again even if they died on this island. But their immortality did not mean it was all right for them to die.
[A Giant Story that has lost its name ceases to exist.]
With every new scenario they are conscripted into, they lose more of their worlds. They forget the lives they once lived, and eventually, even death.
[The Most Ancient Good (善) urges the reincarnators toward Good.]
[The Most Ancient Evil (惡) forces the reincarnators to choose.]
Most of the dead had probably never thought about vast concepts like Good and Evil.
Han Sooyoung closed a dead reincarnator's eyes. With those eyes closed, the reincarnator's face was, of course, neither Good nor Evil.
[You must choose a camp to intervene on this battlefield!]
“I will choose my camp.”
As Yoo Joonghyuk spoke, Han Sooyoung narrowed her eyes and asked.
“You aren't thinking of trying something, are you? You two had a huge fight before we went to the Kaizenix Archipelago.”
Yoo Joonghyuk stared at her without answering. Han Sooyoung thought she could tell what he was thinking from his exasperated expression. Just as she was about to yell, he answered.
“This war must become our fight, rather than the 'Great War of Saints and Demons.' This must not be someone else's battlefield.”
Kim Dokja’s Company's fight, rather than the Great War of Saints and Demons.
Han Sooyoung immediately understood what he meant.
“Only then can both Good and Evil be denied victory. And that is probably how Kim Dokja wants this to unfold.”
“I understand what you mean, but that's a very hard road.”
Han Sooyoung immediately objected.
“That'll make enemies of both the Demon Realm and Eden at once.”
“You were the one who said this was not the 1863rd round.”
Han Sooyoung pouted, looking as though she'd taken a hit.
“Kim Dokja······ What a relentless bastard. He's the only one who'd come up with something like that and call it a solution in a situation like this.”
“He has always been like that.”
“So are you. You're exactly the same.”
At that, Yoo Joonghyuk answered bluntly.
“You don't seem so different yourself.”
“Whatever. I'm different from idiots like you. Enough talking. Let's get moving.”

In the distance, she could see Kim Dokja getting beaten up, surrounded by angels. Well, after he had abruptly declared himself Evil in the middle of that camp, it was understandable that <Eden>'s angels would tremble with a sense of betrayal.
Yoo Joonghyuk declared.
“I will not hold back.”
“Who said you should? I'm planning to kill you too if you piss me off.”
“Good. That should make it a fight worth having.”
“Let's settle our unfinished fight from Kaizenix right here.”
The two of them vanished toward the battlefield at the same time. Abruptly left alone, Lee Hyunsung wailed.
“W-wait! Sooyoung-ssi! Joonghyuk-ssi! What am I supposed to do?”
“Figure it out yourself!”
[The incarnation 'Han Sooyoung' has chosen her camp.]
[The incarnation 'Yoo Joonghyuk' has chosen his camp.]
[The camp chosen by the incarnation 'Han Sooyoung' is Evil (惡).]
[The camp chosen by the incarnation 'Yoo Joonghyuk' is Good (善).]
At last, their 'Great War of Saints and Demons' had begun.
The great plain of the Main Island, where all Heaven's forces had gathered.
Metatron, the leader of Heaven (天界), was receiving situation reports from the other Dominions inside a tent modeled after his office.
―<Olympus> has expressed its intention to participate.
―<Vedas> has also sent word that it will participate.
―<Papyrus> says it will send some constellations as well.
―<Asgard> has also declared its entry into the war. With its own Giant Story to deal with, it seems unlikely to send many constellations.
―There has been no contact yet, but we have seen movement from <Emperor> too. It has long been known for pursuing both peace and war······.
―'Hell's Scribe' is working diligently in the neutral zone. Thanks to those efforts, participation is reportedly rising sharply among both constellations and reincarnators.
Metatron took careful notes on every report, then transmitted appropriate responses.
This 'Great War of Saints and Demons' scenario—quite literally a war with the fate of Good and Evil at stake.
Accordingly, Metatron was being careful, very careful, with this scenario.
[This camp currently has 56 Absolute Good Points.]
And so far, the war had been proceeding smoothly.
Except for one special restriction added specifically to this 'Great War of Saints and Demons.'
[The current Chaos Point total is 51.]
Chaos Points. When he had asked about them, the Great Dokkaebi had answered.
―We very rarely provide a stage of this scale for a clash between old Giant Stories. So, in accordance with probability, there must be a corresponding risk.
―What do you mean?

―A detailed explanation would spoil the fun, so I won't go on. Just remember this. Whatever happens, you must not let the Chaos Points reach 100. Do you understand? Something truly terrible will happen if they do.
Great dokkaebis cared nothing for the fate of nebulas. They were obsessed solely with making more sensational scenarios. Chaos Points were probably the product of just such a wicked scheme.
[I'm bored, Scribe.]
It was Michael, sharpening his sword in a corner of the tent.
[I'll bring back Agares's head. Let me out.]

Defeated by Kim Dokja and Yoo Joonghyuk in the Middle Island scenario, Michael had tasted humiliation twice. He had restored his incarnation body through his resurrection power and entered the Main Island scenario. Metatron smiled faintly at him as he burned with determination.
[Then the war would end too quickly.]
[Isn't it better for a boring war to end quickly?]
[No. This war must be longer and more harrowing than any scenario that has ever existed.]

Metatron looked at the feeds transmitted from all across the region. Those who had chosen Good or Evil of their own will were raising weapons against one another. For now, they were mercenaries joining a war, but Metatron knew that would change as time passed.
[The Most Ancient Good (善) encourages the great holy war.]
Someday, the constellations participating in this war would hate one another in the names of Good and Evil. That hatred would burn anew, creating Stories for future generations.
Watching the war's progress, Michael spoke sullenly.
[Then at least let me finish off those <Kim Dokja’s Company> bastards. I owe them a debt.]
Metatron shook his head. <Kim Dokja’s Company> was an important variable in this scenario, a force to be used as much as possible while they could still be used.
[Perhaps before, but not now. I have another use for them. If you intervene, Michael―]
It was then that a scenario message sounded.
[The 113th local battle of the 'Great War of Saints and Demons' has been forcibly ended.]
Metatron checked the details attached to the message.
The 113th local battle was the one Uriel had joined.
[······Forcibly ended?]
No such message had ever appeared before.
Nor was that the end of the messages.
